The '''Premiere starter deck rulebook''', titled '''''The Rules''''' on its cover, is the 40-page card-sized rules booklet that [[Decipher]] packed in [[Premiere Limited|Premiere]] starter decks. It was the first ''Star Wars Customizable Card Game'' rulebook, published in 1995 and printed in Belgium by Carta Mundi.<ref name="prem-rulebook-scan">[https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15MVULZxbmcEeBmBOToMO1axiH2zLUUKW Rulebook (from Premiere Starter Deck)], 20 two-page TIFF scans of the 40-page booklet in the public "SWCCG Scans" Google Drive folder (owner not shown; uploaded April 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261112195026/https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15MVULZxbmcEeBmBOToMO1axiH2zLUUKW Internet Archive]</ref> The [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] came with a larger rulebook, and Decipher's 1996 FAQ gave page numbers from both books.<ref name="faq96-intro">[https://web.archive.org/web/19961219031209/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/faqs/introduction.html Star Wars Customizable Card Game: FAQs – Introduction to the FAQ], Decipher.com (archive, 19 December 1996)</ref>

The booklet opens with The Basics and the flow of the Force. It then describes each card type: locations (sites and systems), characters, vehicles, starships, Interrupts, Effects, weapons and devices. The Rules section covers deck building and the turn phases (Activate, Control, Deploy, Battle, Move and Draw), followed by More information, a Glossary, the credits and Decipher's contact details. The back cover lists the turn sequence.<ref name="prem-rulebook-scan" />

The full booklet is [[Media:Decipher_Premiere_Starter_Deck_Rulebook_1995.pdf|Decipher_Premiere_Starter_Deck_Rulebook_1995.pdf]].
